title: PeterGanuRusty: how it works and what we measured

cues.text: Three simple code lookups.
{turns_ref} turns.
{tok_ref} tokens.
Every turn, an AI coding agent reads its whole conversation again.
Now the same lookups, with PeterGanuRusty.
One question.
One answer.
The stream shortens to {tok_best} tokens. {pct} fewer, in {turns_best} turns.
It gives an agent four things.
Where a function is defined, and what calls it, in one lookup.
Search by meaning: describe a job, get the function.
What a change reaches, before the edit.
And findings, remembered between sessions.
To measure it, we ran {agents} agents on one Python repository of {files} files.
Three questions, graded against the syntax tree, on three model classes: light, mid and top.
{configs} ways of finding code, ranked. The best one is marked.
Runs fully correct: {perfect_best} of {runs_best}. With no index, {perfect_ref} of {runs_ref}.
The limits are real: one repository, a few runs for each setup.
The study measures the first two things only.
